rules: persist call_id and attempt before actual read, including failed/crashed reads
restart same call_id does not reset budget; new explicit call needs actual new reads; no automatic loop
absolute monotonic earliest applicable deadline; record actual starts/ends/timeouts and queue NOT_VISITED
deterministic structure/version/hash/reference failure immediately rejects without read retries

unattempted_absence.clock: Monotonic absolute deadline; the whole-entry 8s includes gate acquisition, both reads, immutable-file IO and final transaction. Each step uses the lesser remaining entry/parent deadline and its existing step bound; never stack a new 8s budget after a timeout. Existing gate limit is at most 5s and SQLite busy limit at most 1s, both truncated by remaining deadline.
unattempted_absence.on_timeout: No fact/event/index commit; preserve progress and all pending state. Existing independently committed observation metadata and unindexed immutable files may remain as diagnostic evidence.
unattempted_absence.intent_budget: This action has no intent, so do not invent an obligation/intent or consume/reset another intent budget. Existing reconciliation stays at most 3 readonly attempts per intent per recovery invocation; this separate entrance performs only the fixed two reads with no automatic retry.

unattempted_unknown_commit: Query current full-book context by permanent (journal_id,canonical_target_key,action_id); verify event/resource hashes. Never resubmit for discovery.

exit_codes.0: query/reconcile completed or NO_ACTIONS; not quality success or automatic dispatch

frozen_fault_points.durable_fact: No committed new intent if commit fails; target dispatch count must remain zero.
frozen_fault_points.expected_recovery: Query state and stop/reprepare; no automatic dispatch from an uncommitted intent.

frozen_fault_points.durable_fact: Intent exists; the marker alone does not establish whether a target call was possible.
frozen_fault_points.expected_recovery: Treat as unresolved and perform a new independent read-only observation.

frozen_fault_points.durable_fact: Dispatch boundary event exists; it does not prove effect/absence.
frozen_fault_points.expected_recovery: Observe first; never resend the old action.

frozen_fault_points.durable_fact: Independent target effect/log survive even without response/receipt.
frozen_fault_points.expected_recovery: New-process observation and MATCH resolution; effect count remains one.

frozen_fault_points.owner: delivery.mock and runtime immutable evidence writer
frozen_fault_points.durable_fact: An observation may exist without a committed receipt; it is historical evidence, not the next recovery call's fresh observation.
frozen_fault_points.expected_recovery: New recovery observation with new sequence/time; preserve old bytes.

frozen_fault_points.durable_fact: Exact receipt is committed; reopening retains receipt and complete history.
frozen_fault_points.expected_recovery: No replay; query/reconcile according to effective unresolved state.

additional_observation_windows: permit issue/consume and target precommit gate
unattempted first/second read, prewritten resources, final CAS and fact/event/index commit
attempt pre-registration then crash and same-call restart
timing_evidence: Use actual monotonic intervals and parent harness finite deadline. Record scheduling allowance as observation; do not silently raise approved implementation bounds or use fixed sleeps as concurrency proof.
